# Styling Guidelines

## Tailwind

- Extend via `tailwind.config.js`
- Use uniwind for React Native

## Global Styles

- Modify `src/global.css`
- Import Tailwind utilities

## Class Merging

- Use `clx` utility
- Handles conditional classes, prevents conflicts
